report:
Lung, left lower lobe, completion lobectomy

The specimen consists of a left lower lobe completion lobectomy specimen (150 g, 140 x 95 x 40 mm). The pleural surface is smooth and glistening. Sectioning shows the previous staple line with surrounding fibrosis; no residual tumour is identified grossly.

(4) Bronchial margin, shave.
(5) Vascular margin, shave.
(6-7) Lymph nodes, station 7.
(8-9) Lymph nodes, station 10L.

(12) Background lung.
